qualifier: agonist receptor signalling via ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and collagen
name: Platelet activation by ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and collagen receptors
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, aggregation, degranulation and haemostasis; unlike the confusables (VWF variants, G12/13-Rho, integrin cytoskeletal modules) the theme is defined by agonist receptor cascades (P2Y1/P2Y12, PARs, TP, prostacyclin, GPVI).

core: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage
name: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage, including lipophagy
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation, fusion, disassembly and lipophagy plus restraint of triglyceride breakdown in fat-storing cells, whereas confusables centre on triglyceride synthesis, catabolism or fatty acid oxidation.

name: Nuclear pore complex disassembly and postmitotic reassembly
rationale: All three members concern nuclear pore complex assembly/disassembly around mitosis, distinct from lamina/nuclear membrane remodelling and SUMOylation confusables.

name: MECP2 control of neuronal gene expression and excitability
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation, its Rett-associated binding defects and its neuronal targets (GABA signalling, receptors, channels, action potential, calcium channels); unlike confusables they lack the HDAC/NCoR corepressor and broad behavioural phenotype terms.

name: Non-canonical Wnt planar cell polarity and convergent extension
rationale: Members are Wnt/PCP and Wnt/Ca2+ signalling, PCP protein localisation and convergent extension in gastrulation and neural plate, distinct from hedgehog/neural-tube patterning, left-right asymmetry and Wnt secretion confusables.

name: Oxidative and nitrosative stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate intrinsic/neuronal apoptosis in response to hydrogen peroxide, hyperoxia, hypoxia and reactive nitrogen species; nitrosative stress and apoptotic regulation distinguish it from HMOX1, ferroptosis and ischaemia confusables.

name: mRNA polyadenylation and deadenylation-independent decapping decay
rationale: Members cover co-transcriptional cleavage and polyadenylation and decapping/XRN-mediated decay, distinct from histone stem-loop processing, deadenylation-dependent decay and mRNA stabilisation confusables.

name: Scavenger receptor-mediated uptake and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members are scavenger receptor classes A/B/F/H, RAGE and hyaluronan uptake alongside apoptotic cell recognition and engulfment; unlike confusables they lack microglial, amyloid and foam-cell terms.

qualifier: glycine cleavage and PLP-dependent serine metabolism
name: Protein lipoylation, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and PLP-dependent glycine-serine metabolism
rationale: Members are lipoylation-dependent PDH/OGDH/OADH/DLD complexes and lysine catabolism plus glycine cleavage, serine and vitamin B6 metabolism, distinct from TCA cycle, BCKDH/beta-oxidation and broad amino acid confusables.

name: Smooth muscle contraction and relaxation in micturition and peristalsis
rationale: All members regulate smooth muscle contraction or relaxation, with urinary tract contraction, micturition and peristalsis distinguishing it from gastric, vascular and reproductive smooth muscle confusables.

name: Mitochondrial genome transcription and mitochondrial RNA turnover
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination, mt-RNA processing, stability and decay and mtDNA maintenance, distinct from mitochondrial translation, mtDNA replication and RNA modification/ribosome assembly confusables.

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
name: mRNA stability and silencing by small RNAs and RNA-binding proteins
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing, ARE-binding protein mRNA decay/stabilisation, deadenylation and decay, distinct from translation, mRNA export, splicing and transcription confusables.

qualifier: by RNA polymerases II and III (type 3 promoters)
name: snRNA gene transcription by RNA polymerases II and III
rationale: Members are Pol II and Pol III (type 3 promoter) transcription of snRNA genes and U6 snRNP formation, distinct from tRNA/5S Pol III transcription and spliceosome confusables.

name: Reproductive organ development, gonadotropin signalling and placentation
rationale: Members span gonad/genital development and sex determination, ovarian follicle cycle and gonadotropin/activin/AMH hormones, and trophoblast/placental development, whereas confusables centre on meiosis, gametes and fertilisation or on mammary/prostate/pancreatic glands.

qualifier: self nucleic acid tolerance (ADAR editing, TREX1)
name: Endosomal TLR7/8/9 signalling and self nucleic acid tolerance
rationale: Members regulate TLR7/8/9 and IRF5 signalling and restrain type I interferon through ADAR A-to-I editing and TREX1, distinguishing it from RIG-I/cytosolic sensing, OAS/PKR and TLR3 confusables.

name: B cell receptor signalling and its activating and inhibitory regulation
rationale: All members are BCR signalling or its positive and negative (CD22, inhibitory receptor) regulation, distinct from Fc receptor, CD28 costimulation and mast cell confusables.

name: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling
rationale: Members concern presynaptic vesicle endocytosis, clathrin uncoating, vesicle recycling and transmitter release/uptake, distinct from presynaptic cytoskeleton/clustering and dopamine confusables.

name: TLR3-TRIF signalling to necroptotic cell death and IRF3 activation
rationale: Members are TRIF/RIPK1-mediated necroptosis and TBK1/IKKe-IRF3 regulation downstream of TLR3, distinct from caspase-8/TRAIL apoptosis, TRIF-NF-kB and TLR3 deficiency confusables.

name: Flow shear stress mechanotransduction and eNOS activation
rationale: Members are PIEZO1-mediated shear/mechanical load signalling and eNOS activation, trafficking and NO synthesis, upstream of the NO-cGMP, SRF and hydrostatic-pressure confusables.

qualifier: brown/beige differentiation and fatty acid cycling
name: Brown and beige adipocyte thermogenesis and fatty acid cycling
rationale: Members cover brown/beige fat differentiation, cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis and fatty acid transport/cycling, distinct from white adipogenesis and glycerol/aquaporin confusables.

name: Mitochondrial protein import and cristae membrane organization
rationale: Members concern protein import into mitochondria, cristae formation, outer membrane organization and fusion, distinct from mitochondrial protein processing/degradation and respiratory complex assembly confusables.

qualifier: centromeric cohesion and spindle checkpoint control
name: Centromeric cohesion and spindle control in mitotic chromosome segregation
rationale: Members cover sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution, CENP-A deposition, condensation, kinetochore/spindle checkpoint and PLK1/Aurora A control, distinct from cohesin loading and centrosome/cytokinesis confusables.

core: Second-messenger signalling to protein kinase C
name: G beta-gamma and BCR second-messenger signalling to protein kinase C
rationale: Members are G beta-gamma (PLCbeta, PI3Kgamma, BTK) and BCR second-messenger signalling plus PKC regulation and phorbol ester response, distinct from BCR regulation, Fc-gamma receptor and LPA receptor confusables.

core: Defective DNA glycosylases in base excision repair
name: Defective MUTYH, OGG1 and NTHL1 glycosylases in base excision repair
rationale: All members describe disease-variant MUTYH, OGG1 or NTHL1 glycosylase defects and glycosylase displacement by APEX1, distinct from NEIL defects, normal glycosylase recognition and downstream gap-filling confusables.

core: Cofactor metabolism and reactive metabolite detoxification
qualifier: vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors; reactive carbonyl damage control
name: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors, reactive carbonyl damage control
rationale: Members combine PLP and molybdenum cofactor biosynthesis with detoxification of methylglyoxal, aldehydes and sulfide and repair of protein/DNA damage, distinct from sulfur amino acid, selenium, lipoylation and urea cycle confusables.
